decisions.reason: No additional Event is needed because the existing message-171 MODIFY already updates e_l_scale to the required height relationship without leaving stale attributes.
The decision changes the surrounding E and L height relative to the second V; it does not change the second V's proportional construction or right-arm derivation.
The Hero V remains the unchanged reference; matching the E and L height to the second V does not alter its master geometry.
The request to verify the existing copy/paste accent rule does not modify its already established literal derivation.
The E and L cap-height change does not alter the shared baseline rule, which the same message separately accepts.
The second-V height decision does not change kerning; the independent selection of Variation B is already captured by the candidate's message-171 MODIFY.
The decision changes the alphabet's cap-height relationship, not the existing peak alignment between the Hero V and É accent.
Scaling the E and L around the locked second V is consistent with the existing revision policy and does not change which assets are locked or how they must be preserved.
The height refinement follows review of the comparison proof but does not change the requested proof format, comparison dimensions, or review purpose.
The geometric height adjustment has no effect on the deferred champagne material treatment or its application constraint.
The source decision concerns letterform hierarchy and does not change the requirement to provide rationale with design rounds.
Adjusting the relative height of the E, L, and second V does not change the selected all-caps case treatment.
